rows.note: get_manifest_schema_path and load_manifest_schema open the schema file, then compare the required set, the property set, the policy enum, and the idempotency pattern with the RepairManifest model. validate_repair_manifest_json checks one instance. Recording those names in facts is not that loader call.
load_manifest_schema raises FileNotFoundError when the schema path is missing. validate_repair_manifest_json does not open a path.
get_manifest_schema_path follows the prefix share directory when the repo schema is hidden. No vector resolves a schema path.

execute repairs a fixture and then checks that the emitted object contains the required names, the schema_version const, a matching idempotency pattern, and a policy enum member. validate_repair_manifest_json does not execute a repair. emitter_to_dict is one synthetic object, not that execution.
